title: Circuit satisfiability and exact three-CNF
statement: Let $C$ be a Boolean circuit with $n$ input bits, and let $g$ be its number of gates. The circuit has an input assignment on which its output is true if and only if its associated exact-three-CNF formula has a satisfying sign assignment on $n+g+3$ coordinates (that is, an assignment for which the formula evaluates to $-1$).
hypotheses_covered: $C$ is a Boolean circuit with $n$ input bits
